title: mzPeak metadata.factor_values
description: Governs mzpeak_index.json.metadata.factor_values — the OPT-IN (SM-07) projection of SDRF `factor value[*]` columns. Emitted ONLY under the --project-factor-values flag; default conversions omit this key entirely (lean projection posture, Q9/RATIFIED-G — the verbatim embedded SDRF/ISA blob is the authoritative carrier). Run-filtered: only the matched run's samples appear (same scope as metadata.sample_list). SDRF only in v0.8 (ISA factor projection is a tracked follow-up). One entry per factor column, each carrying the per-sample levels (deduplicated by (sample, value), first-seen order). Three-places rule: this file + src/sdrf/project.rs (project_factor_values) + docs/sdrf-isa-study-design-integration.md (§9).

items.description: One SDRF study factor (from a `factor value[NAME]` column) and the per-sample levels observed for the in-scope rows.

factor_name.description: The factor name extracted from the SDRF header `factor value[NAME]` (e.g. "disease", "time"). Lowercased, matching the stored verbatim header.

levels.description: The per-sample factor level for each in-scope sample, deduplicated by (sample, value) in first-seen row order. Empty factor cells are skipped.

sample.description: The SDRF `source name` of the sample this level applies to (matches a metadata.sample_list entry's `name`).

value.description: The verbatim factor level value for this sample, e.g. "lung adenocarcinoma" or "24h".
